title: Terrain and buildings block model in 3D, central Abha

headline.label: triangles in a 1.71 MB GLB model

data: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001 by NASA JPL (1 arc-second grid, about 30 m, reprocessed from the February 2000 SRTM radar data, heights relative to the EGM96 geoid), tile NASADEM_HGT_n18e042; a window was read without an account from the Microsoft Planetary Computer (STAC collection nasadem, anonymous SAS token) on 2026-11-20.
method: Chose the window: 2 × 2 km around 42.505° E, 18.2165° N in central Abha, because its relief is 94 m, above the 60 m required, and OpenStreetMap maps 284 buildings in it.
Reprojected the DEM to UTM 38N (EPSG:32638) and resampled it to a 10 m grid by bilinear interpolation.
Turned the grid into a triangle mesh: 40,401 vertices and 80,000 triangles, not simplified because the file stays under 8 MB without it.
Extruded each building from the lowest terrain height under its footprint to its roof: from the height tag, else building:levels × 3 m, else a default 6 m.
limits: It is a first sample of Madar's own open-source pipeline. The terrain is NASADEM, a radar surface model of about 30 m captured in February 2000. NASA's user guide gives the SRTM specification as 16 m absolute vertical error at the 90% level and cites a global assessment of about 6.8 m average absolute height error; NASADEM reprocesses the same radar data.

model.alt: Interactive 3D model: We built a 3D model of a 2 × 2 km window in central Abha from NASA's NASADEM and OpenStreetMap buildings, exported as one 1.7 MB GLB file. It holds 80,000 terrain triangles and 284 buildings extruded from the ground.
